KuroganeOS 7.0.0-dev — Iron Shield / Driver & Device Expansion

This media begins the 7.0 Driver & Device Expansion line on top of the exact
6.0 Core Steel candidate qualified at
717e003b34d47c81495e8ac5c580ae57c5fb16b3.

Initial Iron Shield scope:
- production Intel Ethernet device-family policy shared by E1000 and E1000e;
- Intel 82540EM remains the legacy E1000 backend;
- Intel 82574L is promoted from MSI-X-only qualification hardware to the normal
  production network path;
- the generic NetworkInterface, DHCP, TCP, TLS and application layers remain
  unchanged by concrete Intel NIC selection;
- QEMU smoke infrastructure gains an explicit e1000e profile so 82574L must
  obtain DHCP and reach the gateway instead of being treated as compile-only
  support.
- PCI device power-management foundation parses the standard PM capability,
  exposes D-state transitions and avoids replaying write-one-to-clear PME status;
  no automatic suspend policy is enabled yet.

7.0 remains a development milestone. The wider target includes Realtek
RTL8111/8168-class networking, VirtIO net/block expansion, PCnet legacy
coverage, audio fallback coverage, USB hubs/wider HID and device power
management.

Qualification boundary:
Core Steel 6.0 automated QEMU qualification remains attached to its exact SHA.
Iron Shield requires its own exact-SHA host, release-media and concrete-device
runtime gates. VirtualBox, VMware and physical machines remain external
validation until directly observed; unavailable environments are never
reported as PASS.
